summary: Linked airlocks only close each other if they aren't yet closed

comments.content:
I notice airlocks in the animated state won't be affected if the other airlock is
clicked on (ie: stand between two airlocks and click them both in rapid succession =
both open). This behaviour hopefully corrected in that patch?

No, and I'm not sure whether that needs correction or not. Being able to open both
airlocks is useful a lot of the time (especially for unnecessary linked pairs like
the one above the bridge). There might be a better way to do it, but the current one
is fine for now, I think.
